_about.description: Research index for the Aetherforce Living Library. Links works to themes, concepts, and cross-references. Maintained by Synthesist.

works.title: Torsion Fields and Their Experimental Manifestations
key_claims: Physical vacuum is a material medium with phyton structure (nested electron-positron ring packets)
EM, gravity, and torsion are polarization states of the same vacuum
Dynamic torsion fields have constants not constrained to be small (unlike static torsion)
Torsion technology applications: energy, propulsion, materials, communication, geophysics, astrophysics

works.title: Torsion Fields and Torsion Technologies
key_claims: All inertial forces are generated by torsion fields (geometry of absolute parallelism)
Cartan's torsion hypothesis (1922) extended to dynamic regime
Samokhvalov experiments show mass repulsion in vacuum chamber — non-gravitational, non-electromagnetic
Tolchin's inertoid changes momentum using only internal inertial forces
Filatov found violation of momentum conservation in gyroscope collisions

works.title: Gravity in the Theory of Compressible Oscillating Ether
key_claims: Gravity is compressive (pressing) force, not attractive
Gravitational constant is not constant — depends on chemical composition
No gravitational waves or gravitons exist
Derives Maxwell-Lorentz, Coulomb, Biot-Savart from ether equations
Electron/proton/neutron mass formulas match experiment to fractions of a percent

works.title: Foundations of Etherdynamic Natural Science, Book 5: Initial Etherdynamic Experiments and Technologies
key_claims: Ether wind detected via laser and interferometer experiments
Geopathogenic zones linked to ether absorption by Earth
Lepton foam effects on metal, photographic paper, dielectric permittivity
Longitudinal propagation of electric waves
Ether dynamic approaches to energy crisis

works.title: Rigorous Study of a Light Scalar Field Coupled to Matter in Galaxies: Application to Rotation Curves
key_claims: Scalar field Φ coupled to baryonic density modifies effective gravitation
Field mass ~10⁻²⁷ eV/c², coupling α ~ G
Testable and falsifiable alternative to dark matter on SPARC data
Third path between MOND and dark matter

works.title: Inertial Buoyancy of the Vacuum and Cosmic Expansion — A Universal Inertial Constant Revealed by Φκ
key_claims: Vacuum possesses measurable inertial density (60.3 ± 1.3 × 10⁻³¹ g/cm³, Planck 2021)
Φκ scalar field replaces dark matter and dark energy
Inverse Pressure/Volume law validated on 20 galaxies across 4 cosmic filaments
Falsifiable predictions on Tully-Fisher relation and equation of state w(z)

works.title: TUO: Classical Formalisms and Correspondence — From Maxwell and Einstein to the Vacuum Tension Field Tv
key_claims: Vacuum tension Tv is a state property, not a force field
Tv has no gauge symmetry, no quanta — acts on metric not through it
Replaces cosmological constant Λ with dynamic local term
Gravity derivable as g = −∇Tv (bridge to Michaud's confined EM theory)

works.title: Form Waves: Origin, Principles, and Controversies
key_claims: Geometric shapes emit specific waves (form waves) detectable by pendulum
Chaumery and de Belizal founded form wave theory in 1930s
Negative green wave associated with mummification
Carrier wave principle enables distance transmission — basis of radionics

works.title: Morphic Resonance – Rupert Sheldrake
key_claims: Morphogenetic fields organize systems in biology, chemistry, physics
Morphic resonance: past forms influence present organisms non-locally
Natural regularities are habits, not immutable laws
Morphic fields are informational, non-energetic — not recognized by physics

works.title: The Platonic Theory of Everything and the Spyridis Unified Theory of the Electro-Strong Interaction
key_claims: Platonic solids encode mathematical structure of physical unification
Pythagorean harmonics (cube as geometric harmony: 6-8-12) relate to physics
Unified theory of electro-strong interaction via Platonic geometry
